## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes, and `npm run preview` looks right on a phone and a desktop
- [ ] No inline scripts or styles (`<script>`, `<style>`, `style=""`): the CSP in `public/_headers` blocks them
- [ ] Brand assets changed in [xena-studios/brand](https://github.com/xena-studios/brand) and synced with `npm run brand:sync`, not edited in `src/brand/`
- [ ] A new page is listed in `src/pages/sitemap.xml.ts`
- [ ] Links to other sites carry the External arrow, and the copy follows [PRODUCT.md](https://github.com/xena-studios/website/blob/main/PRODUCT.md) and [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/xena-studios/website/blob/main/DESIGN.md)
- [ ] The README is updated if the setup changed
